title: Service Booking MVP (deposit + dynamic fields)
summary: Portfolio demo template: guest browse → pick service → lock slot → optional deposit; intake fields change per SKU (home visit address, salon notes, etc.) — config, not rebuild.
problem: Freelance booking jobs often need more than a Calendly embed: service catalogs, deposits, and per-SKU intake fields (address, pet breed, vehicle type). Rebuilding the front end for each vertical is slow and hard to demo credibly.
solution:
Self-built portfolio demo (not a client delivery). The H5 MVP at bz.a shows the standard path: browse services without a login wall, pick a slot with double-booking protection, fill dynamic fields that vary by SKU, and optionally pay a deposit when payments are enabled.

Simple vs complex on the same stack: the lightweight calendar template (tpl-booking-calendar.vercel.app) covers single-resource week view + confirmation — enough for bid screenshots. The bz.a H5 adds catalog, deposit/tail payment states, and configurable intake — proof of a full business MVP without a separate rebuild per industry.

Screenshots are illustrative demo UI, not real client brands or revenue claims.

zh.title: 服务预约 MVP（订金 + 动态字段）
zh.summary: 作品集演示模板：访客浏览 → 选服务 → 锁档 → 可选订金；按 SKU 切换 intake 字段（上门地址、沙龙备注等）——改配置，不重做前端。
zh.problem: 接单里的预约需求往往不止 Calendly 嵌入：要有服务目录、订金、以及按 SKU 变的 intake（地址、宠物品种、车型等）。每个行业重做一套前端又慢又难在投标里讲清楚。
zh.solution:
自建作品集演示（非客户交付）。bz.a 的 H5 展示标准路径：免注册浏览服务、防双订选档、按 SKU 填动态字段、支付开关打开时可付订金。

同一技术栈上的「简单 vs 复杂」：轻量日历模板（tpl-booking-calendar.vercel.app）覆盖单资源周历 + 确认页，投标截图够用；bz.a H5 叠加目录、订金/尾款状态与可配置 intake，证明完整业务 MVP，无需每个行业单独重做。

截图均为演示 UI，非真实客户品牌或收入数据。
